historical_record.description: The former Farragut School, surplus to the school district and proposed for a long-term lease and housing, was a three-storey building of 36,940 square feet on a lot of 61,875 square feet.

The City Planning Commission rezoned the former Farragut School site from P (public) to RH-1, 6-0, and approved, 5-1, a planned unit development of up to 54 dwellings on it (Resolutions 8755 and 8756).
